definitions.explanation: Wood that has been carried along by a river or washed up on a shore. Often used decoratively in aquariums and gardens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浜辺|はまべ}→浜辺：17948_hamabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{流木|りゅうぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was driftwood on the beach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流木|りゅうぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{流|なが}れ{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: After the typhoon, a huge amount of driftwood washed up on the coast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}って→拾う：00845_hirou⟧きた{流木|りゅうぼく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{素敵|すてき}な⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: He made a beautiful table out of driftwood he had picked up.

notes:
Compound of {流|りゅう} (flow) + {木|ぼく} (wood). Refers to wood that has floated downstream or been carried by the sea. Frequently associated with beach scenes and natural disasters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {流木|りゅうぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{流|なが}れ{着|つ}く: driftwood washes ashore
- {流木|りゅうぼく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧: to pick up driftwood
- {流木|りゅうぼく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧: driftwood furniture
- アクアリウム⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流木|りゅうぼく}: driftwood for aquariums
